h1: The 7 Best Mini Chainsaws Under $200, From 6 Inch Pruners to 12 Inch Saws, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Mini Chainsaw Under $200: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 mini chainsaws under $200 from RYOBI, DeWalt, Greenworks and SEESII, compared on bar length, motor type and batteries.
summary: The RYOBI HP 18V Brushless 6 inch kit is the best mini chainsaw under $200 for most buyers, a ready-to-run brushless saw from a major brand. The RYOBI 8 inch bare tool is the pick for ONE+ owners, the 12 inch 20V two-battery kit gives the most reach for the money, and the SEESII 12-Inch is the brushless option for longer cuts.
intro: At the $200 mark the label mini chainsaw starts to blur. Some of the saws here have 6 inch bars you can wave one-handed at a hedge, while others carry 12 inch bars that are small chainsaws in everything but name. The hidden tradeoff is control: every extra inch of bar adds reach, but also weight and kickback leverage. Buying the longest bar you can afford is a classic mistake.

This ranking sorts seven saws by bar length, motor, battery platform and what is in the box. We reviewed listing details rather than inventing performance numbers, and where a listing is quiet about something, such as the motor in a 12 inch kit, we say so. Bare-tool listings are flagged because a battery can change the real price.

products.name: RYOBI HP 18V Brushless 6 in. Compact Pruning Mini Chainsaw Kit
products.verdict: A brushless 6 inch kit from a mainstream brand with a huge battery family behind it.
products.description:
RYOBI's HP 18V pruner has a brushless motor and a 6 inch bar, sold as a kit. HP is the maker's high-performance range, and the 18V ONE+ batteries are shared by a long list of other tools.

It takes first place because it balances all the things that matter in a mini saw: light weight, an efficient motor and a platform you can grow into. A 6 inch bar is easy to control and accurate for pruning. Check the kit contents on the listing, since kit definitions vary.

Buy it for orchard, hedge and garden work. Skip it if you need to cut logs.
products.idealFor: Gardeners wanting a precise, light pruner.

products.name: RYOBI 18V Brushless 8 in. Battery Compact Pruning Mini Chainsaw (Tool Only)
products.verdict: An 8 inch brushless RYOBI bare tool, ideal when you already hold the batteries.
products.description:
This RYOBI has an 8 inch bar and a brushless motor, supplied as a bare tool. It uses 18V ONE+ batteries that you must own or buy separately.

It ranks second because it adds bar length over the kit while keeping the brushless advantage. Two extra inches is a real step up in cut capacity. The cost of a battery and charger is the catch for beginners.

Choose it if you already run RYOBI 18V. Skip it if you are starting out.

products.name: 12" Electric Chainsaw Cordless, 20V Battery Powered Cordless Chain Saw, Chainsaw with 2 x 4.0Ah Lithium ion Battery and Charger
products.verdict: A 12 inch, 20V saw with two 4.0Ah batteries and a charger, at a very low cost.
products.description:
This 12 inch saw runs on 20V and includes two 4.0Ah lithium-ion batteries and a charger, aimed at wood cutting, trimming and pruning.

It ranks third because 8.0Ah of stored energy and a 12 inch bar give the most capacity per dollar here. The compromise is control and brand: a long bar is heavier, and the listing does not name a brand or motor type. At 20V, it also has less torque than the 40V saws.

Buy it for trimming and softwood on a tight budget. Skip it if you want brand support.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who want maximum reach.

products.name: SEESII 12-Inch Electric Chainsaw Cordless, Brushless Motor
products.verdict: A 12 inch SEESII saw with a brushless motor and very little else in the listing.
products.description:
The SEESII 12-Inch is a cordless saw with a brushless motor and a 12 inch bar. The listing gives no battery detail.

It ranks fourth because brushless is a good sign but the missing battery information makes it hard to judge value. The longer bar gives reach, and SEESII sells batteries separately, so check carefully what you receive.

Pick it if you want a brushless 12 inch saw. Skip it if you need to know the box contents.
products.skipIf: You need a stated battery kit.

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12 in Cordless Electric Chainsaw, 2.0 Ah Battery and Charger
products.verdict: A 12 inch, 40V Greenworks saw with a 2.0 Ah battery and charger.
products.description:
This Greenworks 40V saw has a 12 inch bar and ships with a 2.0 Ah battery and charger.

It ranks fifth because the 2.0 Ah battery is small for a 12 inch bar and the price is higher than the generic kits. What you gain is brand support and a 40V platform with a range of tools.

Buy it if brand warranty matters. Skip it if you want long runtime.
products.idealFor: Brand-minded owners with light cutting needs.

products.name: Dewalt Chainsaw Pruning CRDLS 20V 8IN DCCS623B
products.verdict: DeWalt's 20V 8 inch pruning chainsaw, best when you own the batteries.
products.description:
The DCCS623B is DeWalt's 20V pruning chainsaw with an 8 inch bar. The B in the model number commonly signals a bare tool, so check for a battery before you buy.

It ranks sixth because the RYOBI 8 inch matches the bar for less and names a brushless motor, while the DeWalt listing does not. The reason to pick it is the 20V battery family.

Buy it if you already hold DeWalt 20V packs. Skip it if you would need to buy one.

products.name: Greenworks 24V 6in Mini Chainsaw, 2.0 Ah Battery and Charger
products.verdict: A simple 6 inch Greenworks saw with a 2.0 Ah battery and charger.
products.description:
This 6 inch Greenworks 24V saw includes a 2.0 Ah battery and charger.

It ranks last because it offers the least cutting capacity at a brand price, and no motor information. For light pruning it works, and the 24V battery serves other Greenworks tools.

Buy it for gentle shrub work. Skip it if you want more bar.

methodology.title: Bar length and control
methodology.description: Six, eight and twelve inch bars were compared for reach against weight and kickback risk.

methodology.title: Motor type
methodology.description: Brushless motors were weighed above unstated ones for efficiency and heat.

methodology.title: Battery platform and kit
methodology.description: RYOBI 18V, DeWalt 20V, Greenworks 24V and 40V, and generic 20V packs were compared, with tool-only listings flagged.

methodology.title: Brand support
methodology.description: Established tool makers were scored above anonymous kits for parts and warranty.

methodology.title: Value under $200
methodology.description: Each saw was set against the $50 to $100 and $100 to $200 buckets, counting a battery if one was needed.

whatMatters.detail: A 12 inch bar reaches farther, but it is heavier and increases leverage if the saw kicks back. For hedges and thin limbs, 6 inch is enough. Buy the shortest bar that handles your thickest regular cut.
A brushless motor uses electronic commutation and wastes less energy as heat. It gives longer runtime from the same battery. Check the listing title for the word brushless.
Bare-tool listings exclude batteries, which can cost as much as the saw. Kits include them. Read for the words tool only or battery and charger included before comparing prices.
Higher voltage platforms such as 40V provide more power for longer bars. 18V to 20V suits pruning. Pick the platform that matches your existing batteries.
All chainsaws can kick back, mini ones included. Keep both hands on the saw, wear eye protection and gloves, and avoid cutting with the bar tip.

howToChoose.intro: Shorter bars handle better; longer bars cut thicker wood.

faq.q: Is a 12 inch saw still a mini chainsaw?
faq.a: Marketing calls it one, but it is a compact chainsaw. The 6 and 8 inch saws are true pruners, while the 12 inch models cut small logs.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake buyers make?
faq.a: Buying the longest bar available. A longer bar adds weight and leverage, which makes the saw harder to control in tight spots.

faq.q: Is the RYOBI worth it over the generic 12 inch kit?
faq.a: For pruning, yes. The RYOBI is lighter, brushless and backed by a brand. For small logs and firewood, the 12 inch kit gives more reach.
Quick. Mount the bar and chain, set tension, fill the oil and charge a battery. Follow the manual for chain direction.
Keep the chain sharp and oiled, clean sawdust from the bar and store the battery partly charged. Replace a stretched chain promptly.

faq.q: Are cordless saws safe for beginners?
faq.a: They are easier to start and quieter than petrol saws, but they cut just as fast. Learn the basics, wear protective gear and start with small branches.

finalTake: The RYOBI HP 18V Brushless 6 inch kit is the best mini chainsaw under $200, combining a brushless motor, a controllable bar and a large battery family. The RYOBI 8 inch suits owners with batteries, the 12 inch 20V kit gives the most reach for the money, and the SEESII 12-Inch is the brushless long-bar choice. Pick the bar for your branches, not the biggest one available.
